en: This is a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a well-maintained park with benches and flowerbeds along a walkway, with trees and a large building in the background. The caption in German at the top reads 'Bad Pyrmont Partie im Kurpark,' indicating the scene is from a part of the spa park (Kurpark) in Bad Pyrmont, Germany. The reverse side includes lines for an address, a space for a stamp, and the text 'F. Pietsch, Bad Pyrmont' on the left, along with a museum logo and handwritten numbers.
